mapper.select: SELECT tracking_process_id, request_tracking_id, tracking_process_identifier, tracking_process_type, federated_twin_id, federated_digital_object_id digital_twin_id, digital_object_id, tracking_command, tracking_kafka_group, tracking_kafka_topic, data_filter_type, event_occurred_count, event_condition, event_delay, event_end_date, tracking_status, tracking_status_change_time, create_time FROM tracking_process_info A WHERE 1=1 AND request_tracking_id = #{requestTrackingId}

SELECT A.tracking_process_id, A.request_tracking_id, A.tracking_process_identifier, A.tracking_process_type, A.federated_twin_id, A.federated_digital_object_id A.digital_twin_id, A.digital_object_id, A.tracking_command, A.tracking_kafka_group, A.tracking_kafka_topic, A.data_filter_type, A.event_occurred_count, A.event_condition, A.event_delay, A.event_end_date, A.tracking_status, tracking_status_change_time, B.task_processing_id, B.task_processing_status FROM tracking_process_info A inner join tracking_task_processing_info B on B.tracking_process_id = A.tracking_process_id AND B.request_tracking_id = A.request_tracking_id WHERE A.tracking_process_id = #{trackingProcessId} and B.task_processing_id = #{taskProcessingId}
